calls.statement:
-- Calculate average basket value (receipt total) by store format for period 4 FY2026/27
-- Period 4 is 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30
WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    f.receipt_id,
    f.store_key,
    s.format,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as receipt_total
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' 
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
  GROUP BY f.receipt_id, f.store_key, s.format
)
SELECT 
  format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) as receipt_count,
  ROUND(AVG(receipt_total), 2) as avg_basket_value
FROM period_sales
GROUP BY format
ORDER BY format

  f.store_key,
  s.store_name,
  s.format,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,

-- Check web order handling - verify web sales are in fact_sales_line
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as web_receipts_in_sales_line,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) as web_orders_total
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' 
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'

-- Check what's happening with Web format - look at the actual sales
SELECT 
  f.channel_code,
  f.store_key,
  s.store_name,
  s.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipt_count,
  ROUND(AVG(f.net_amount), 2) as avg_line_value
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' 
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
  AND s.format = 'Web'
GROUP BY f.channel_code, f.store_key, s.store_name, s.format

-- Final query: average basket value by store format, excluding Training
-- Period 4 of FY2026/27: 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30
WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    f.receipt_id,
    f.store_key,
    s.format,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as receipt_total
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' 
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
    AND s.format != 'Training'
  GROUP BY f.receipt_id, f.store_key, s.format
)
SELECT 
  format,
  ROUND(AVG(receipt_total), 2) as avg_basket_value
FROM period_sales
GROUP BY format
ORDER BY format
